name: Free Shockwave VFX for Godot 4

nodes.doc: Global settings and the one-line helpers of BLASTLUX.

methods.name: spawn
methods.signature: spawn(parent: Node, preset: Variant, position: Variant = null) -> Node
methods.doc: Instances a preset under `parent`, moves it to `position` and plays it; a one-shot frees itself when done.

methods.name: shake_hint
methods.signature: shake_hint(point: Vector3, radius: float, camera_pos: Vector3) -> float
methods.doc: How hard a camera at `camera_pos` should shake for a blast of `radius` at `point`: 0..1.

methods.name: warmup
methods.doc: Draws every shader (and preset, if names are given) once, tiny, so the first real blast does not stall on shader compilation.

nodes.doc: Base of every BLASTLUX 3D effect: the clock, one-shot bursts, fading, the palette, wind, the dynamic light and the layer list (one MeshInstance3D + ShaderMaterial per layer).

methods.name: make_layer
methods.signature: make_layer(shader: Shader, mesh: Mesh, priority: int = 0) -> ShaderMaterial

methods.name: set_layer_own_transform
methods.doc: A layer that keeps its own transform (a shell on a target mesh) instead of the identity.

methods.name: set_light_level
methods.signature: set_light_level(level: float, color: Color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)) -> void
methods.doc: Light strength 0..1 (and more for a flash); the node's light_energy scales it.

methods.name: ground_below
methods.signature: ground_below(from: Vector3, reach: float, fallback: float) -> float
methods.doc: y of the first collider below `from` (reach metres down), else `fallback`.

properties.name: core
properties.doc: The white-hot centre of the fireball and the flash.

properties.name: cool
properties.doc: The cooling edge of the fireball, embers and sparks.

properties.name: dust
properties.doc: Dust the blast lifts off the ground (the skirt and the ground ring).

properties.name: light
properties.doc: Light the blast throws on its surroundings (the OmniLight3D and the heat on scorched meshes).

properties.name: scorch
properties.doc: Soot left on meshes and the ground.

nodes.doc: The wave on its own: a dust ring racing over the ground, a translucent pressure disc that stands up through the air, and a heat ripple that bends what is behind it (Forward+ and Mobile; Compatibility shows the ring and the disc).

properties.name: radius
properties.doc: How far the wave travels, in metres.

properties.name: ring
properties.doc: The dust ring on the ground.

properties.name: dust
properties.doc: Low dust puffs the ring kicks up.

properties.name: disc
properties.doc: The pressure disc that stands up through the air.

methods.name: wave_at
methods.doc: Moves to `point` and sends the wave out.

caveats: The heat ripple (`ripple` on `BlastluxShockwave3D` and `BlastluxShockwave2D`) reads the screen texture and is not drawn on the Compatibility renderer; the ring and the disc carry the wave there.

notes: `Blastlux.spawn(parent, "shockwave_dust_ring", point)` sends a wave from `point`; `BlastluxShockwave3D.wave_at(point, radius)` does the same on a node you keep.
The heat ripple reads the screen texture and is not drawn on the Compatibility renderer; the ring and the disc are.
`Blastlux.quality` (LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH) scales the dust count; `Blastlux.wind` drifts the dust.
